item.title: Somali pirate and Houthi alliance targets $1T oil trade route with revived hijack tactic
item.description: Analysts warn of a Red Sea security vacuum as Somali pirates and Houthi-linked groups allegedly collaborate using new tech to hijack oil tankers.

item.title: Cargo ship attacked by small craft near Strait of Hormuz, UK maritime agency says
item.description: A large cargo ship was attacked near the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday as Iran pushes to assert control over the vital global energy shipping route.

item.title: Trump’s 'Economic Fury' squeezes Iran — but can Tehran outlast the pressure?
item.description: Trump's escalating sanctions, naval blockade and financial enforcement against Iran test whether economic strain can force Iran's regime to bend.

item.title: Israel defense chief warns strikes on Iran could resume soon, signals campaign not over
item.description: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz warns military action against Iran may resume soon, saying Tehran has suffered severe blows throughout the past year.

item.title: Iran’s $800M oil smuggling scheme uses tankers posing as Iraqi ships to dodge blockade
item.description: Sanctioned tankers are allegedly disguising Iranian oil shipments as Iraqi cargo while Trump doubles down on the naval blockade to squeeze Tehran.

item.title: Global famine fears rise as Hormuz crisis threatens ‘eight-year,' Suez-scale disruption
item.description: Global famine fears are rising as the Strait of Hormuz crisis strains food supply chains, drives up fertilizer prices and threatens harvests worldwide.

item.title: Leaked audio shocker: UK envoy says US ‘special relationship’ not with Britain, but another ally
item.description: Britain's ambassador to Washington reportedly said America's special relationship is probably with Israel, igniting diplomatic controversy in London.
